title: The app still uses local filesystem artifact storage and has incomplete upload lifecycle APIs

original_titles.title: Object storage is a local directory, not a private bucket
Upload lifecycle incomplete: validate/get/delete endpoints and status=ok submit gate missing
Only the filesystem storage adapter; no MinIO/S3 option despite spec pluggability
Staged uploads cannot be deleted before submit
Challenge upload has no file-count cap and the repo tree is not virtualized

problem: storage.py is a local-directory adapter. Uploads can be staged and submitted, but there is no full validate/get/delete lifecycle surface for stale staged artifacts. File-count/manifest limits and repository tree virtualization remain incomplete.
impact: A single VM disk becomes a storage and availability failure domain; abandoned staged uploads may accumulate, and large repositories/uploads can produce UI/server load.

evidence_paths: backend/app/routers/levels.py: upload_artifact and submission artifact queries
verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Set explicit limits for artifact file count, compressed size, uncompressed size, nesting depth, per-file size, allowed file types and path traversal. Validate zip expansion ratios and symlink entries.
Add staged artifact GET/status/delete endpoints bound to owner, level and state. Allow deletion only before submit; retain audit metadata after submit.
Implement S3-compatible private object storage with server-side encryption, lifecycle cleanup and content hash verification. Keep object keys non-public.
Add a cleanup job for expired staged uploads and a quota check per participant/team/event.
Virtualize large repo/file trees and test large ZIP, zip-bomb, duplicate path, traversal, symlink, cross-user access and storage failure.

acceptance_criteria: Artifacts cannot be read/deleted by another user.
Staged-but-not-submitted files can be deleted and expire automatically.
Private object storage is used in production or the local-storage D0 limitation is explicitly signed off.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
